So the theme here is about the impermanence of life but the hope that your name or legacy lasts forever. It's about mortality and legacy.

So someone who walks today on the ground, tomorrow their body's dust will be in the air. That's about the transience of life, the body turning to dust, very much about mortality and the fleeting nature of existence. Similar to option 1 but maybe more focused on the physical body becoming dust.

Option 3: "هیچ کس نیست که او را به جهان دردی نیست - وانکه دردیش نباشد به جهان هیچ کس است". Translates to something like "No one is without pain in this world, and if someone has no pain, then they are not in the world." So this is saying that everyone experiences pain; if you don't have pain, you're not really part of the world. So the message here is about universal suffering, that pain is inherent to existence. So it's about the inevitability of suffering in life.
